scope: test lot up to 20 stations plus controlled spares

official_sources.use: layer count, copper, finish, drill, plating and minimum geometry
standard PCBA process and inspection capability
Micro-Fit 18 AWG terminal rating and insulation range
Micro-Fit 20 to 24 AWG terminal rating and insulation range
20 to 24 AWG strip, crimp-height and pull-force process values
18 AWG wire construction, outside diameter and temperature
24 AWG wire construction, outside diameter and temperature
22 AWG control wire outside diameter and temperature
M8 battery ring terminal identity and conductor range

pcb_main.fabrication_process: JLCPCB public standard or customer-selected equivalent meeting every value below
pcb_main.coupon: fabricator standard controlled-impedance coupon and TDR report when offered by checkout

pcb_pwr.fabrication_process: JLCPCB public standard or customer-selected equivalent meeting every value below

pcb_mic.fabrication_process: standard two-layer FR-4 prototype PCB plus standard PCBA

acoustic_land_pattern_exception.scope: MK1 manufacturer-derived ground land only; no signal trace or zone
acoustic_land_pattern_exception.acceptance: clean 0.8 mm acoustic bore, no copper breakout, no plating, no burr, no solder/paste/adhesive obstruction

pcb_mic.panelization: vendor standard tooling rails; V-score prohibited through leaf; route tabs outside MK1 acoustic and H1/H2 zones
pcb_mic.depanel: supported low-stress routed-tab removal followed by 100 percent acoustic-port inspection

inspection: visual inspection of polarity, connector seating and PCB-MIC acoustic path

main_apertures.U2: 1.85 x 0.55 mm per pad, long axis follows land
main_apertures.U9: use exact controlled footprint apertures from the component land-pattern drawing; no automatic 1:1 paste substitution

first_article.release_after: SPI/AOI/X-ray disposition plus rail-current-limited smoke and interface tests

evt_acceptance.order_checkout: customer confirms stackup, copper, finish, impedance option and zero unresolved file-parser/DFM errors
evt_acceptance.harness: 100 percent continuity, polarity and cross-short; first-off crimp height and destructive pull; end-to-end resistance; strain relief and flex
evt_acceptance.electrical: rail drop, startup, modem burst, I2C at 100 kHz and four-channel PDM/AAD
evt_acceptance.thermal: +70 C powered thermal run at representative maximum load
evt_acceptance.cold: -40 C continuity and functional start; includes M8 ring-terminal joint
evt_acceptance.acoustic: four-channel phase/gain/noise and unobstructed PCB-MIC acoustic path
evt_acceptance.series_transfer: repeat DFM, process-capability, environmental and supplier/tooling qualification before serial lot
